pageDesc.settings: Manage external services, API keys and system settings.
pageDesc.llm: Cloud providers (Anthropic, OpenAI), local models (Ollama) and embedding configuration.
pageDesc.mcp: Register Model Context Protocol servers — extend agents with external data sources and tools.
pageDesc.gitea: Internal Git server for project management and code collaboration.
pageDesc.giteaToken: API token from Gitea → Settings → Applications
pageDesc.giteaOrg: Organization or username under which repos are created
pageDesc.github: GitHub Personal Access Token for repo access and issue management.
pageDesc.vpn: Connect HydraHive instances via a private network (Tailscale or Headscale).
pageDesc.vpnAuthKey: One-time key to join the VPN network — from the Tailscale/Headscale admin panel
pageDesc.kas: All-Inkl KAS credentials for automatic email mailbox creation.
pageDesc.kasLogin: KAS username (e.g. w012345e) — from the All-Inkl KAS panel
pageDesc.kasPw: KAS password — not the email password!
pageDesc.kasDomain: Default domain for new mailboxes (e.g. your-company.com)
pageDesc.kasSmtp: SMTP server for outgoing mail (e.g. dd12345.kasserver.com)
pageDesc.users: Create user accounts, assign roles and manage access permissions.
pageDesc.backup: Full backup of all data, projects and configurations. Regular backups are recommended.
pageDesc.plugins: Community plugins extend agents with additional tools and capabilities.
pageDesc.schedules: Scheduled tasks — call agents automatically at regular intervals.
pageDesc.schedulesCron: Cron expression (e.g. */30 * * * * = every 30 min, 0 9 * * 1-5 = Mon-Fri at 9am)
pageDesc.extensions: Enable or disable optional system components (e.g. Code Server, SearXNG).
pageDesc.voice: Voice control — speech to text (STT), text to speech (TTS) and voice-based agent communication.
pageDesc.federation: Agent-to-agent communication between multiple HydraHive instances via Tailscale or manual peers.
pageDesc.tools: All available tools for agents — each tool extends the capabilities of your agents.
pageDesc.system: System diagnostics, resource monitoring and maintenance — CPU, RAM, disk, GPU and service status.
pageDesc.doctor: Automatic check of all system components. Fix buttons resolve common issues with one click.
pageDesc.cleanup: Clean up old transcripts, backups and logs to free disk space.
pageDesc.search: Web search via SearXNG — privacy-friendly metasearch across multiple search engines.
pageDesc.secrets: Secure storage for API keys and tokens used by agent tools. Only visible to admins.
pageDesc.secretsValue: The secret value — stored encrypted and only accessible by agent tools
